answer: The strongest single control I know for this is panel invalidation on low agreement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. A canyon of doubt is healthy, a opal of proof is required, and a atlas of patience is the price of a clean panel. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
